posts.title: Chest FLOSS Menubar Manager for macOS
posts.description: Chest : Chest is a small, open-source menu bar manager. It hides the menu bar icons you don’t need, either right in the menu bar or in a separate chest. Been trying a bunch of Bartender alternatives in macOS27 — Thaw beta , Dimble , Coat Check , SaneBar , and others — and Chest has been the one that stuck for me. Free and Open Source.

posts.title: Dessa Conversation Model Trained on Speech
posts.description: Ragavan Thurairatnam, on block.xyz : We trained Dessa from scratch on nothing but human conversation. Sounds! No text, no pretrained models. It learned to hold a real-time conversation simply by listening.
